scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:backend && npm run test:unit:frontend
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:backend && npm run test:integration:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all:full: npm run services:up && npm run db:prepare && npm run test:all && npm run services:down
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:unit:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:unit:frontend -- --coverage
scripts.services:restart: npm run services:down && npm run services:up
scripts.db:prepare: npm run wait-for-db && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.dev: npm run services:up && npm run db:prepare && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
